label: PF Backlog 551
title: CI1: workflow installs the declared test deps (jsonschema/httpx/requests/pyyaml) so pipeline tests collect
body:
## Problem
CI's deep-tier `pipeline-tests-full` + `backlog-e2e` fail with `ModuleNotFoundError: jsonschema` (and earlier httpx/pyyaml/requests). The workflow installs a partial hardcoded list, not the project's declared deps.
## Fix
Install `jsonschema` (+ httpx/requests/pyyaml) in `.github/workflows/structure.yml` (or install from `test-framework/requirements.txt`).
## Acceptance
CI pipeline tests collect and run (no ModuleNotFoundError).
